title: Fair Sum vs Mean vs CAMA Classification Comparison with Full Hyperparameters
summary: Demo notebook for the CAMA (Cardinality-Aware Moment Aggregation) experiment comparing 3 GNN aggregation methods (mean, sum, CAMA) on rel-stack/user-engagement classification. The notebook demonstrates: (1) CAMA module implementation with numpy reference code and unit test verifying output shape, gate initialization at ~0.5, and variance enrichment; (2) statistical analysis (Cohen's d, bootstrap CIs, paired t-tests) on 8 pre-computed training runs across 3 seeds; (3) 4-panel visualization showing training curves, final val AP comparison, CAMA gate evolution, and effective rank. Uses pre-computed results from mini_demo_data.json loaded via GitHub URL with local fallback. Results confirm CAMA > sum > mean with Cohen's d=5.14 (CAMA vs mean) and d=1.63 (CAMA vs sum).
